title: Low voltage at Node C (stays low)
description: After 3 s a heavy simulated load pulls Node C down to about 184 V (80 % of 230 V) and keeps it there.
what_to_look_for: Node C changes to 'Checking…' and then to 'Low voltage'.
The status becomes FAULT SUSPECTED; no shutdown is ordered because the supply is still present.

steps.note: Node C voltage falls to about 184 V

button.label: Low Voltage
button.does: After 3 s, Node C's voltage drops to about 184 V and stays low.
button.wait: Node C turns amber after about 4 s; the fault is confirmed after about 7 s (the voltage must stay low for 3 s first).

checks.text: Node C shows Low Voltage (about 184 V).
Isolation command: Not requested (low voltage alone does not cause a shutdown).
